body: Quick pass (M5): the body is complete (fix, pins with mutation results, gates, not exercised: the GUI click and a Hub run; Changelog; `Fixes #1409`). The quick gate is green on 58be8266, plus the lathe, turning, post and MCP suites and clippy app/ui. No goldens or snapshot PNGs changed. #1409 is P3 (not paused). It changes posted G-code (a seeded Facing's heights) plus a creation-door rule (`depth_sane` lets a level Facing window through so generate can refuse it by name), so this needs a safety-tier review. Flagged ready; a review by the other session is next.

Review fix for pullrequestreview-5894381835, pushed as **2164990** (`test(turning): pin the Facing window door - inverted refused, level passes`, Refs #1409). Test-only. No source, golden or snapshot changed.

### New pins (`crates/app/tests/turning_face_seed.rs`, through the MCP door: `add_operation` / `edit_operation` -> `heights_gate`)
- `an_inverted_facing_window_is_refused_at_the_door`: editing `F1` to `top_z` Fixed 47 / `bottom_z` Fixed 48 is refused with `must cut downward`. Creating on a 46 stock under a 48 part (seeded top 46 over a plane at 48) is refused the same way at `add_operation`.
- `a_level_facing_window_passes_the_door_and_the_slightest_inversion_does_not`: 48 / 48 passes the door. 48 / 48 + 1e-9 is refused with `must cut downward`. **Tolerance:** the Facing arm is an exact `t >= b`, with no epsilon. So a level window is the boundary, and a 1e-9 inversion is already on the wrong side of it. The f64 spacing near 48 is about 7e-15, so 1e-9 is a real difference and not rounding noise. The test comment explains this.

### Mutations (each applied to the Facing arm of `depth_sane`, the suite run, then restored)
| Mutation | Red |
|---|---|
| arm always `true` (the M3 hole) | `an_inverted_facing_window_is_refused_at_the_door`, `a_level_..._slightest_inversion_does_not` |
| comparison `t > b` | `a_level_..._slightest_inversion_does_not`, `a_seeded_facing_on_a_part_at_length_reports_nothing_to_face` |
| epsilon `t >= b - 1e-6` | `a_level_..._slightest_inversion_does_not` |
| restored | 5/5 green |

### Gate (head 2164990)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test turning_face_seed --test turning --test heights_selection`: 5 + 6 + 9 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

### Note 3 (wording when the stock is shorter than the part): left as is
This is not a trivial change. The message comes from the shared `heights_gate` in `commands/operation/gates.rs`, which every kind uses. A Facing-specific "the stock's top stands below the part's top - nothing to face" would need either a new kind-specific branch in the door or a second refusal path. It would also have to tell a seeded inversion apart from a hand-typed one, and that changes refusal text that other suites pin. It is better as its own follow-up, as the review suggests. The new create-door pin asserts only `must cut downward`, so that follow-up can add words without breaking this test.

Ready for a re-review.

**Delta re-review @ 21649902** (test-only, since 58be8266): **clean**. The one requested change is done.

- `an_inverted_facing_window_is_refused_at_the_door`: top 47 / bottom 48 on edit, and a create on stock 46 under a 48 part, both give "must cut downward".
- `a_level_facing_window_passes_the_door_and_the_slightest_inversion_does_not`: 48/48 passes; 48/48+1e-9 is refused.
- Mutations on `heights_sel.rs:181` (the Facing arm):
  - `t >= b` → `true`: both new pins **red**.
  - `t >= b` → `t >= b - 1e-6`: the level/epsilon pin **red**.
  - Restored: green.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test turning_face_seed --test turning`: 5 + 6 passed.
- NaN still refuses: `t >= b` is false for NaN.
- Clippy: the only hits are the pre-existing `needless_range_loop` in camcraft-geometry from the newer local toolchain (on main too). Nothing in this PR.
- Wording note: leaving the shared `heights_gate` text as is is fine.

Safety tier: posted words were verified at the previous head and are unchanged.
